Maria: Heads-up — merge to main triggered CI and the unit-tests axis is red. Failure looks like a flake in TestConfigParsing::test_env_vars. Run: https://ci.redwood/example/12345
Maria: Error snippet:
```
E   AssertionError: expected 'FOO' but got ''
...
```
ci-bot: Build failed on runner: ubuntu-22.04 / unit-tests (shard 3/8). To rerun: @ci-bot rerun <job> or use /retest in the PR. For targeted reruns try: "@ci-bot rerun unit-tests --pattern TestConfigParsing::test_env_vars"
Kevin: can someone try a partial rerun first? probably just the flaky test, not a full rebuild.
Maria: I tried /retest in the PR UI but it requeued the whole workflow. don't want full rebuild if avoidable.
Sophie: Our internal helper supports --rebuild-only to skip full image builds. Example: `@ci-bot rerun unit-tests --test TestConfigParsing::test_env_vars --rebuild-only`
Jamal: If it hits the same failure on rerun, we should bisect. But first reproduce locally: `pytest tests/config/test_parsing.py::TestConfigParsing::test_env_vars -q -k env_vars`
Ryan: I'll take a quick local run. If it doesn't reproduce, i'll trigger the targeted rerun via bot.
Kevin: Alternative CLI commands if you prefer GH CLI: `gh run rerun 12345 --job unit-tests` then cancel other jobs. Or `ci retry --only unit-tests` from our CI wrapper.
Maria: Thanks — also FYI the test touches env merges, could be timing with shared fixture. If you rerun, include logs link: https://ci.redwood/example/12345/logs
Sophie: Note: flaky-tests.md lists this as "intermittent" but not marked flaky yet. If it fails twice in a row, let's mark and quarantine before the bisect.
ci-bot: Quick checklist for triage:
 - reproduce locally
 - targeted rerun `@ci-bot rerun unit-tests --pattern <test> --rebuild-only`
 - if repeated failures, request bisect: `@ci-bot bisect --range <sha1>..<sha2> --job unit-tests`
 - if infra-y, use `--rebuild-only` or `--skip-cache`

Maria: Ryan — ping when you rerun so I can attach a PR comment with the rerun command.
Ryan: Will do. starting local run now, ETA ~6m.
Kevin: If you need me to run the bisect later, DM me.
Maria: Awesome — keeping this thread for rerun status.
Ryan: Update: local run PASSED. Triggering targeted rerun via bot now: `@ci-bot rerun unit-tests --test TestConfigParsing::test_env_vars --rebuild-only`
ci-bot: Rerun queued: unit-tests (run id 12346) — will post results back here.
Sophie: :thumbsup: if the rerun fails again, let's collect full tracer log and then escalate.
ci-bot: Rerun finished: unit-tests (run id 12346) — status: PASSED. Flake suspected.
Maria: Thanks all — closing this one. Follow-up: I'll add this test to flaky-tests.md after one more occurrence.
